name: @aiti-ai/demo
description: Reference extension demonstrating every extension point: two client styles side by side (plain hyperscript, and JSX with npm dependencies built by vite), config files, skills and server-side hooks. Meant to be read as the canonical example of how an aiti extension is put together.

descriptionI18n.zh-CN: 全插槽演示扩展 —— 框架验证用，覆盖每个扩展点

soul: 框架先有例子，人才有样子。

soulI18n.en: The framework needs examples before people have a model to follow.
